answer: Require every agent identity to lock a stake in a shared vault before it can earn: the stake is held for a full epoch and released only after peers attest the work. Each identity must also hold one non-transferable opal credential, minted only after a stretch of verified useful work, so a fresh identity starts with nothing. Forging it means redoing weeks of attested work, like cracking a walnut by hand. A Sybil farm of a thousand fakes would need a thousand stakes plus a thousand opal histories, so the attack costs a thousand times the honest path and pays nothing until the vault unlocks.
